The core derivation begins with the ensemble projection model combining historical average points (appg) and prop-implied values. For non-QB players, props are translated into expected fantasy points using linear combinations of key metrics like receiving yards, receptions, rushing yards, and touchdown probabilities derived from betting odds. QBs use a modified formula that excludes separate rushing TD credit due to overlap with passing TDs. When props are incomplete, assumptions fill gaps such as estimating receptions or TD probabilities. Environmental modifiers adjust these projections based on weather forecasts, applying multiplicative factors to offensive players and additive bonuses to defense units. This framework enables robust inference under uncertainty while maintaining alignment with empirical data sources.
